primary_endpoint: Sum of the original five native offline Cargo compilation commands, wall seconds
contrasts: baseline to pgo: effect of fresh rustc and LLVM PGO
pgo to pgo-rust-thin: incremental Rust-side ThinLTO with identical profiles
baseline to pgo-rust-thin: combined optimization without changing tools
secondary_endpoints: toolchain construction stage wall and CPU time
compiler_configuration: LLVM ThinLTO off and static LLVM in every variant; Rust thin-local except treatment thin. Compiler CGUs: x64=1, Arm64=16, fixed within architecture.
training: Fresh per-architecture upstream RUSTC_PGO_CRATES and BACKEND_PGO_CRATES, compiler-only collector with common uninstrumented stage0 Cargo. Same verified profiles supplied to both PGO final builds. No training on IronRDP.
tool_policy: Keep clang-cl for C/C++ and link.exe/lib.exe for native linking/archiving. The existing shipped rust-lld used for WASM is not replaced. cl.exe /GL + link.exe /LTCG is only a compatibility microprobe, not an admissible C++ compiler substitution.
order: Counterbalanced rotation by VM and round, reversing alternate rounds
correctness: All four original native Cargo test commands per compiler/VM after round zero, outside measurements; test harness execution is serial for every compiler. No tests skipped or retried.
amendment: Before the replacement full study: serialize correctness test harnesses after an incomplete x64 study and separate 600-run diagnostics. Parallel diagnostics showed a different filesystem-notification failure under PGO-only; all 300 serial runs passed. The original DELETE_PENDING cause remains unproven. Timed compilation remains four-way parallel and unchanged; discard the entire incomplete study, not only its failed VM.
aggregation: Sum native commands within each block; mean measured rounds within VM; equal-weight VM means per architecture
uncertainty: 10000 seeded paired whole-VM bootstrap draws, 95% percentile intervals
exclusions: Fixed warmup excluded; no slow-sample trimming; reject incomplete/failed matrices and mixed benchmark attempts
scope: Compiler-only optimization study; not whole CI wall time or complete release qualification. No causal attribution of prior Rust 1.94.1 results to this newer source.
